# Kenney Train Kit 1.1

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/train-kit (Kenney's upload).
Canonical pack: https://kenney.nl/assets/train-kit.
License: CC0 1.0. See the original LICENSE.txt.

The two GLBs and Textures/colormap.png are unmodified files from the ZIP's
Models/GLB format directory. Subway A is the leading car of an oncoming
train. Subway B is the coach and the car used on stationary trains.
The game fits the meshes to the original train collision dimensions at load time.
